purpose.en: Build the backs of your arms and your chest.

text.zh: 手肘直直往后弯，肩膀别耸
text.en: Bend your elbows straight back and keep your shoulders down

text.zh: 双手撑在椅面前沿，膝盖弯着，双脚踩地。
text.en: Put your hands on the front edge of the seat, knees bent and feet flat.

text.zh: 下到大臂差不多和地面平，再撑回手臂伸直。
text.en: Lower until your upper arms are about level, then push back up to straight arms.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging or letting the shoulders roll forward.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时下得浅一点或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, go less deep or switch to an easier version.

cautions.zh: 用结实、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.

changes: 名字「臂屈伸」含术语「屈伸」，改为「椅子反撑」
口令「推起」改「撑起来」（0.7 s）
节奏核对：动画顶点真正静止约 0.37 秒（<0.8），rep_hold 改为 rep_updown
